data.name: Kylen
data.gender_notes: Kylen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Kylos, meaning 'cylinder' or 'tube'. In ancient Greece, a cylinder was a symbol of power and strength. Thus, Kylen can be interpreted as a young warrior or a strong, vigorous person. The name Kylen carries the meaning “Young warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kylen usually hope their child will grow to embody young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, resilience, and determination in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Kylen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kylen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
